Fellow Patriot,

The radical Left has been more outraged and aggressive than I've ever seen in the past couple of weeks. The Left has gone to new lengths to threaten Republicans and intimidate us into submission. Unfortunately for them, it's not working.

When I announced I was running for re-election, I knew this time it would be different. The Left has never been more out of control and ready to take us down than right now. We will not stand for these baseless attacks, but we will always stand for our country.

The days of civilized discourse and debate have been destroyed. Our country is on the wrong track under the Biden administration. Crime is rampant, inflation is skyrocketing, and our family values are under attack.

The Left is destroying the American Dream. That's why I am running for re-election: I want future generations to know and love the country that has given us so much. **_The problem is:_** millionaire Leftists are pouring money into the campaigns of Woke candidates who will only make the situation worse.

My good friend, Chuck Grassley, is also running for re-election and facing a Radical Leftist candidate who will immediately destroy all that Chuck has accomplished for the people of Iowa.

I am very worried that we will not be able to regain the Senate majority this fall if conservative incumbent candidates cannot gain the support we need from patriots like you, Fellow Patriot. _**[Are you willing to help out?](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=bb89ea78f9da4cf380180cba5224625c&_e=ay_XUc46ibQrqDciNAJwDjbhfJ3FqkyvLKmyXBCzI4JCCkPmG8rxy7pe6TJ-4-4WVWINI5uVne5ymeSV-grL-rE41czx0v9J1KxVy8fNEEnMhtckrV_ASscV56R2i-Cbb9pR-ZjsOU1iizjD05xynLuCTuG6dFQbDhsNmRHPVqOaYJUHbChhzKCvJFspaMpKK-6-rwCTzTPE6AcxVM1DosUi23jcNShSOeJhf7TgyD_YywCe6cpYkE_31Gvx0ARRDIRPstWBV6m8u_jUhmODqR5ux89pK1t0dn74Y6nhxz2wICGncJ6u79qS2sKXIDz0M_bNGUpRDXSEr5rzT0UuddidLIvSzhypFsP3oAGm-D0Fv1iSCGmPsu_SBoYd24o6tgNVcKRszlW8OUonFU-tt6DEr3tLOLE_S76oyT_ag9ikwbsdXqt0J73c8lPXW7IIvi6QcITZom37hFmnjElRgZyasqnF8sZuLs2XTjYUveFfCmMpxk5obA-NRm-c53MXcWb73Yd1rVZhSQJQsOS2Dg%3D%3D)**_

I really hate asking for money. But when it comes down to it, we have no chance of winning without this support since Democrats are backed by millionaire celebrities.

No donation is too small. Even $10 makes a difference. Thanks to your contribution, we can reach undecided voters and ensure a victory in November. With your support, I am confident we can Take Back the Senate.

Our future is on the line. I sincerely thank you for your support.

Many thanks,
Ron

Shea Roberts recently shared this powerful story with Stacey and other
women who spoke about their experiences involving difficult choices about
her reproductive health:

When Shea became pregnant, she was 38 and already a mother to two
daughters. Later in her pregnancy, her doctors ran blood tests that
indicated Trisomy 18 — a chromosomal disorder that would mean her child
would live only a few days, hours or even minutes after birth.

It was then that her doctors recommended having an abortion. The pregnancy
risked Shea's health as well as the livelihoods of her young daughters,
who were dependent on her at the time.

It “was a horribly traumatic time in my life. Probably the worst, darkest
time I can think of," she said.

For many women, a choice like this is one of the most difficult they'll
ever make. And without that choice, Shea would have been risking the life
she had built for her family.

But under Brian Kemp’s dangerous abortion ban, there's no telling how many
women's lives are in jeopardy. And there's certainly no telling how many
women like Shea will be affected for years to come if Brian Kemp is
reelected.

Stacey has promised to combat Kemp's extreme, dangerous abortion laws the
minute she steps into the Governor's office. She plans to fight
tooth-and-nail to protect the women of Georgia — not endanger their lives.

This is not a fight we will win easily,
Derek. But it is one we can
win — together.

Since taking office, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation, restore the middle class, and unite the country. We put hundreds of millions of shots in arms, passed one of the single largest investments in infrastructure in American history, and put the first African American woman, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, on the Supreme Court. Every bit of progress we’ve made has been possible because of folks on this grassroots team. But if MAGA Republicans win this year, women could lose the right to choose anywhere in America. The right to contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy -- could be at risk. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. As a pastor serving in the Senate, I’m committed to showing that there is light, there is hope even when things feel dark.

Right now, we’re in a similar moment:

We are witnessing politicians restrict voting rights and women’s choice all over the country.

Voter suppression laws have been passed right here in Georgia that make it illegal to pass water out to folks waiting in lines to vote at the polls.

And again, right here in Georgia, we’re witnessing politicians rush to restrict women’s right to make their own health care decisions after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0746%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=kl0ysUmV8Ll2E7aJ4km3zg&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34081%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KttFXOMuMKw4%2f1k9VdMYdA&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34082%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lMB69hMDppMGYNh9WB6ghw&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34083%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fmD%2bLiKPXzNXVPD5xjDsNQ&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34084%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TOWI6H2yrAxt%2b7Em5IXv0A&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34095%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=snan85Vk8rHJjdPClM%2bgtA&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34096%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c1lZjngfdgOOdL%2betsTxdQ&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34097%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d5uhMUG6fcSkZBSdR8PsGg&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34098%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4YsfRQxpXCPuUzOHUqAzOQ&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34099%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZOFNrmd4oXESwA213OEnUQ&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34090%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XB%2bb3wZiQM8NyPKgVtklnw&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34091%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cOt0yNCdVOdaOgI9Xi5ovA&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34092%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nyGUOBDPCcAUdV5IBA%2bf3g&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34093%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CcJ88C95zcnJZqUCdHJ4wg&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34094%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NIfcVXAT2KrvIxpVnkndmA&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34005%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=e4cdiGGUFlMCDfn6%2byj1ug&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34006%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pHKeEW8ybxOBpPWXs63yqA&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34007%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=awVS4tx4%2fDLY%2bgkdsQ2KwA&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34008%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=782rgY%2fu9rx9yQETl8gI0Q&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

Friend,

_**Our country used to be respected, but Biden has turned America into a third-world nation.**_

name: Madison Gesiotto Gilbert
subject: I gave birth on Monday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Madison for Congress
body:
By Tuesday, Nancy Pelosi was attacking me for being pro-life
| | |
---
| | Fellow Patriot,
---
On Monday September 19th, 2022 my husband and I welcomed our son — Marcus Christopher Gilbert Jr. — into the world.
---
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zuo1jkimh09dhiruumcjj9vgdn3pe8lfo6iev6r0_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)
---
| | Just look at how happy we were, Fellow Patriot... That is until Nancy Pelosi came into the picture.
**_As we were enjoying our first moments as a family, my campaign team reached out to tell me that Nancy Pelosi launched a six-figure ad campaign against me for being pro-life. _** On what should’ve been one of the best days of my life, I was **CRUSHED** that Nancy Pelosi and her cronies would launch such a despicable attack. Pelosi and her pro-abortion radicals were waging war against me by filling the air waves with ads labeling me “extreme” and “dangerous” all because I dare to stand up for the most innocent and vulnerable among us. _Can you even believe it?!_
---
[**HELP ME FEND OFF THEIR ATTACKS**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4agl6tk6s3ao7eh1pepgp67o505k620griafhqo_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)
---
| | Nancy Pelosi showed that there is no level she won’t stoop to to hang on to her power as Speaker.

Look, I know how nasty career politicians can get when they are in danger of having the rug pulled out from under them and losing their power. But this level of vitriol and complete disregard for my newborn son and I is unlike anything I have ever experienced before. **[Will you defend me?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zkdhd3l89bueil2i92733p4kgm6g82a9hm7bhd3o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)** Let’s get one thing straight: Nancy Pelosi doesn’t give a damn about you and your family anymore than she does mine.

**Nancy Pelosi's priorities start and stop with Nancy Pelosi.**

But I am running for Congress as the antidote to the disease that is self-serving career politicians. I’m an outsider who’s never run for public office before — Pelosi is **TERRIFIED** that the American people will **FINALLY** hold her accountable.

I have always been passionate about helping my community. I have always been unapologetically pro-life. And I have always been an America First free-thinker.

Now that I have experienced the blessing that is motherhood, the passion and fire within me has only intensified.

_**[So to Nancy Pelosi, I say this: BRING IT ON!](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi1t6n68253rca8oham8rg5j0gvjb8p8c221t28g_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs) **_

**Throw all of the disgusting attacks at me that you want — this Mama Bear is not going to back down. I have too much to fight for. ** But this fight is not just Madison vs. Nancy. This is about the American Dream vs. an American NIGHTMARE. In Pelosi’s American Nightmare... criminals get off scot free, borders are wide open and education is replaced with indoctrination.

But the American Dream that I am fighting to protect is centered around law and order. A nation where leftist activists don’t dictate what students learn, and parents are put in control of their child’s education. Where putting America FIRST is not just a catchphrase, rather a way of life.

**[I can win this fight, but I can’t do it alone. Nancy Pelosi is attacking my family now, but it will be your family next. Help me put a stop to Nancy Pelosi and her radical henchmen.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z88hk9hnvkk3gtr1fvj3mqtrp2169g71qjjlia40_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)**

Thank you for joining me,

Madison Gesiotto Gilbert

**_P.S. Any help you can provide will go a long way toward me winning this TOSS-UP district. My opponent is getting bailed out by her big-wig allies in Washington. I’m still working to get back on the campaign trail, but I’m at a SEVERE disadvantage until I fully recover. I had our finance team create this secure link for you to rush in support before it’s too late:[_MadisonForCongress.com/FightBack_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjma9ekaojq9od5f4kvj2pshrbrbckdlps58fq8o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)_**
---

---
[**CONTRIBUTE**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsekm0fic33vdnr3v40bt05ubmpkpso89ji2prao_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg60o36cdh2bs)
---

Dear Fellow American, Does America need a “Great Reset?” In 2020, members of the world’s elite met at the World Economic Forum and launched the Great Reset initiative to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab—the founder and executive director of the Forum—wrote, “we need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, this would have the effect of canceling our American way of life. A recent Hillsdale College seminar considered the idea of the Great Reset, its ramifications for America, and pro-freedom alternatives. **This seminar—titled[“The Great Reset?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2qgh9jilkdf076tlpfc6dqi5f3r4uetj3vse5h0_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg68o74c5h2bs)****[”](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z78atsjqunul3nm6i66pqvguulfr40qbqeh90al8_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg68o74c5h2bs)[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpo8f64cebisifqjgbntaqvkamqrqn4vl7t5g788_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg68o74c5h2bs)—is now available as a free online video series.**

---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za0ioijpvthmpne6v4euq2ktu0be12681kr6rs9o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg68o74c5h2bs)
---
| |
Filmed on the Hillsdale campus, this video series will give you insight into:
* The origins and leaders of the Great Reset
* How the ideology of “woke capitalism” is infiltrating large corporations
* The connection between a cashless society and the Great Reset
* What “environmental justice” has to do with the Great Reset
* The Great Reset from China’s perspective
* Alternatives to the Great Reset

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdibdbk5s1prrq57i2b48avp8p9nvkgbpbir1oqg_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg68o74c5h2bs)** You will learn about the Great Reset, the dangers it poses, and pro-freedom alternatives. And you can share these lessons with your family, friends, and more. As America’s economy continues to struggle in the aftermath of disastrous elite decisions, lessons like these are essential to the defense of the free market and American liberty. Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Statement From Senate Republican Leader Rob Ortt On Possible Lifting of Travel Requirements at Canadian Border
---
I'm encouraged by recent reports that indicate the additional COVID-imposed travel requirements at the Canadian border may soon be lifted. For months, I have been calling for and to end the confusing and burdensome requirements, including the use of the unreliable 'ArriveCan' app.
Travel to and from Canada has been restricted for more than two years, and it has not only been an inconvenience for many Western New York families, but it has been economically devastating for our border communities.
Our economy in Western New York is directly correlated with our strong relationship with our northern neighbors, and it is well past time to remove the border restrictions placed by the Canadian government that have crippled our economy and stifled the free flow of people and goods between our communities.
I want to thank all the representatives at all levels of government who are working together on a long overdue resolution to this issue.
---

# Leader Rob Ortt & Senate Republicans Urge Labor Commissioner to Reject the OT Threshold Reduction

subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6009%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=bOwcs%2fB5J6h47%2bUYCPEwcA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86764%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jwLIu8vp80k6A7T86xRlBQ&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.** Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

subject: They gave us no warning
body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjei3o8och3m1oig5h2bfjhnt7pn7mht5qnua1fo_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqb6plh6lpmcpjnchq6adr2eph3dc5mcpob8c5lm2p31clk61pjat1lmmoj0pb7mv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664rjbc77mpjmcd72mdgefc5lclp2bs)

|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming — which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zphdmajf9qbgs65anslpiknh4sau0t14jrjsoll8_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh2bs)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjlt1qbb6cvc18sgnepm4mhejg5q4q1cmn6tega0_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh2bs)
---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” — so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5am9d2aungkbr6icn3c1i5m2j7tg4dedn4tj12g_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh2bs) And remember — you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zb56ev180suord6uu9jmnfa2476ihhsa8u7j491o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh2bs) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd3jt8henhkk9l3datd5jp49q0pj99k7j44o0ofo_rp22sh2s8i66or1chg6eoj6chh2bs)

Sincerely, Seth Dillon CEO The Babylon Bee

Hey there,

It’s the Organizing Team at Dan Kildee HQ! With less than 50 days until Election Day, and less than a week until Michiganders can start voting, we just tripled our field team to expand our direct voter outreach efforts across mid-Michigan.

**BUT, this is also the time when the campaign is making its final budget decisions.** It’s in the final days of this month that we make our final campaign plans for the last stretch of the election. And, with more resources, we can grow our efforts to reach more voters about Dan’s work in Congress to lower costs for families and bring good-paying, union jobs to mid-Michigan.

We’re competing with a lot. Millions of dollars in false TV ads are running from super PACs and we have a self-funding opponent who, despite not living here, is trying to use his family’s wealth to buy a seat in Congress.

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---
| | | [ENDORSE RON JOHNSON](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392707:JhQapPVxN:m:1:3317145305:44A03141A5DC5BFD1FB0641FAF171990:r "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON")
---
Thank you,
Ron Johnson
---

---
| It's Ron Johnson.

clean_body: I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. | | | | Peter, I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future. Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014. As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort. By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration. During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future. Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart. As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win. I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear. In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail. Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I have not lost my voice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
Team —

11 years ago, I was shot.

The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.

Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.

With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.

I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close.

Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. So, I’m asking:

Splitting $25 – or anything you can afford – between Mark's campaign and Seth Moulton will go a long way in helping Mark win re-election to continue fighting for the issues we care most about in the Senate.

secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=220925_MK_split

My drive to improve things for the people of Arizona and our country has never been stronger. Mark is working so hard in the Senate to do that, and your support for him means the world to me.

body:

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.** Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can't abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. name: Marco Rubio
subject: Please read even though it's long 🙏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than fifty days until the Election and we're falling behind our End of Quarter Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "4")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.
****[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392633:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |

* * *
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392634:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "POLLS TIED!") I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls.

I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Far-Left progressive groups are pouring in millions of dollars to try to win this Senate seat. The truth is, **I will lose if I don 't have your support.**

Please, Peter, I'm begging: **[Will you chip in right now?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392634:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "Will you chip in right now?")** | | [SEND IMMEDIATE HELP](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392634:JTKsAPVNj:m:1:3253819041:F1272D2813E86464F924AC174A606E5A:r "SEND IMMEDIATE HELP")

Please use this link to give: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lbr-beasley**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51299227/368934448/-1167550852?refcode=EM_FR_220925BeasleySplit_FR_TEAM_90DO_7_NG_NL1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGZlYzA4OC1kYzNjLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AzLGlRMTtbq9oJO8CI17RT2b0j7lW76Ru0PAniSoWuo=) We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Right after Labor Day, everything kicked into an even higher gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars. Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’re doing right now. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale. My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztonsacgh1laq32klaje1d364k3c4a8k5oda3fu8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpr6c3n6hpm2sb165h3fd77cjhbddhksjibat1jmeom2tr3m3hb9dhm6tge8o5gsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664rjbc70eph6cc9kmdj3fc5lclp238h1e8he4933cdgm8p32cdi6coh5u)
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu8ledc68dccd9f82vn3jp2s5sds2dqige4ehkoo_rp22sh2s8i66or1chi64or4cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7nhfp8i96v22n06h235mdsc74222jh860scko2o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chi64or4cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zj4rv1abnvluqtko8v26r4aqtih8km9qahu5as88_rp22sh2s8i66or1chi64or4cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. | | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392725:JI7kmPVYN:m:1:3317145305:C8132AD38050FDEC88BD344C2C128C6B:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

name: Dr. Norman Horn
subject: Biden is dividing our country. Here’s the solution. . .
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392902:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)
Hello Peter,

Did you watch Biden's _Soul of the Nation_ speech?

If so, I'm sure you noticed the same thing I did -- **this is a clear sign that the _real_ soul of American ideals - individual liberty, respecting each other, and peaceful dialogue** \- is in decline.

Biden's speech was dark and disturbing. It was pure power politics. And I fear this is only the start of hate and division growing in America.

Christians must stand our ground against the Federal government. **We must reject power politics and embrace liberty and free markets.** That's why I'm emailing you.

My name is Dr. Norman Horn. I founded the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) with the mission to make the _**Christian**_ case for free markets and free people.

I've set a goal to connect with 300 new supporters this week to spread our message.

[_**Peter, I invite you to join our efforts to defend liberty, preserve morality in our culture, and oppose the evils of empires. I am humbly asking you to send a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount to support our work. Click here to send your support >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392902:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)

The Libertarian Christian Institute believes liberty is the most consistent expression of Christian political thought.

Unfortunately, many conservative and libertarian organizations lack a proper understanding of liberty in the context of faith. They don't know how to communicate these ideas with Christians effectively.

LCI is the only organization fighting for liberty through a Christian worldview.

_The Libertarian Christian Institute believes_ :

* **Christians must root their beliefs in Scripture.**

* **A free society must abide by a Non-Aggression principle **-- the Bible gives us clear instructions to reject violence and force as a way to change hearts and minds. This applies to the government as well. **A free society must abide by a Non-Aggression principle**

* **Individual liberty is critical to achieving peace and prosperity. **

* **Healthy social institutions matter for human flourishing** -- meaning we must not surrender our schools, churches, or even businesses to Woke social justice activists and the enemies of liberty.

* **Christian theology affirms the ideas of free market capitalism:** Jesus instructs us to respect each other's property, to never STEAL from our neighbor, and to be productive citizens.

God already gave us the handbook with everything we need to achieve liberty, peace, and prosperity.

Now it's up to you and me to spread that message.

[_**Peter, can you join LCI in our mission? Click here to send a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392902:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)

We're reaching out to our fellow Christians and libertarians through our online programs, publications, conferences, and meetups.

* **The Libertarian Christian Institute Podcast:** We reach THOUSANDS across the country with our weekly podcast, where we discuss current events and tackle the Christian perspective on things such as School Choice, student loans, Sound Money, and the pro-life movement.

* **Our book,_Faith Seeking Freedom: Libertarian Christian Answers To Tough Questions_ :** We make the Christian case on all the difficult debates of the modern day--why abortion is evil, why taxation is theft, and why believers must reject socialism.

* **Online Content & Events: **We believe that we must reach NEW audiences and folks who may not agree with us on everything. We desire to change hearts and minds, not preach to the choir. LCI publishes online content constantly and presents at conferences to reach people with our message.

But we can't do any of this alone, Peter. That's why I am asking you to consider becoming an LCI sponsor.

We don't have millionaires funding our programs or special interest groups lining our pockets. Instead, we rely on the generosity of people who want to reach America with the Gospel and the ideas of liberty.

Can I count on you to help me reach my goal of connecting with 300 new supporters this week? **Click below.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392903:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392904:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392907:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61392908:JOfKmPVNN:m:1:3331421248:3D7222A1C72D37C516B47DE110A97F78:r)

Dr. Norman Horn

Friend,

When you hear about North Korea, what comes to mind?

The news tells stories of socialism, dictatorship, military maneuvers, and food shortages. But few talk about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me. . .

My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of Communism.

[_**Will you help me tell my story to students across the country? **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3isa2na395mmslkjn6anlfdd8s1u0ded0lla73o_rp22sh2s8i66or1chi62ob4c5h2bs)

Too many young people believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

But they don't understand what an oppressive country really looks like.

Most Americans today don't understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity - starves your soul, mind, and stomach of all that freedom provides.

Young Voice's latest program, Dissident Project, is countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. The Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries, like me, to high schools around the United States to share our stories.

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement ✅
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Patriot,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3Dx_y_dWjk4-pyZ7aakzVA61ok7V4wcIPkEzVnTn_ALB3IINzEac_PZ3Qaa5vrcWaf33wR5QYl6fdmmZ6UAbnemsWoxncuEkKxOkClk2OhSIpeVvyN87aS_NyZnFx0bKgq9Z3CDn557U8f4iRdpRIKpD "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3Dy7SGIiYWgIsmwNR5lFGgDzwF_1ZMaWa9RS09-k-eJGl13tEDOX4wBkh_Res5JwT0Oo-na3jEjteq0T7ZDaRVew2VD9ew2iLyrABtxN9pk6TrUQhuf9x1lhvlSL4BlkQeXny4VeIo1fUI1ldhhDCwVM "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3DzktMqIngx2pzu6Znm8h7V32xMUM4ruYj_mQ7jPxO5KOzu3hIVnjshfUUIXiLxrEDhlLanuKd7UhOe7EP-QlBtU8M5yn9pqmdlrFqtADVkHqjZYHCEqEGMyfv9bGwQJFiXvUHRHU3a3996KbmXED9Ds "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3Dxgnk_D46SKrdpj0HHO0_5Vx46xeYVIqe7Lu7IL8CeLrl8S3tdcLAVHVEtuS4dX-rpnGKuOsF5qoz4TJzqc-9qT2Q5AsNtsyrjHOpdmWfBNvXW9dHGa7sx4Jgj1mHIYuIz9-kwtrC_QACgT8l68kM2i "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3DwlNiMWEF5zANG0r5SfUS_pQtwytCvim3irN10om2OgZWHaOBmHyFGRNKk14Lhbgl94RtC06rM5SVPAwODNNdE5ggUxDxB15WDDeHNnvTjCEirgdvTcHa9ORNU6SDN3O60LKJ9dStSF7PZ7nvBYOjn6 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3DwvAkpMJyfMoP3yOFcuboUehD44iMONjRTosvPlk7277KeEdKmGAk8K8xteeYxd2ic12TUexNU39BZhncWEbPjXeiumG98-DmonnOd3bjNMUszG1BjagHaJlet7YnTahGqzKUaqyFWKjYGn8DxNEqIB "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3DyTrJ3fjs5oTuvTKwWkIho630nZYRjhSmoRM_BHKCjC9zujvxkbpHYZAID0V7KBIk0nPretE5DsmmoYDtdlk_NSKv6q87LKvFWsX5nnkwu66KzFPlzqUNudE9Rc9vYvA24DJ7Qe-TjdnYPgSdo9RD8H "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b12495c1701d462189fdf35f9ca1052e&_e=jeLLX0RUUmuslzodKGa9JZzBIS9_DFLCZGQ302s1F0rL8hzrgMbZHFcix57XlcGW_xwlzgekOJKV-oKkNQcg0S8bvzTX_v5kR7vcgsoEJzrpIYay3l0oKOp1fLN3-q6U-tyCTIhP8nR29ymynXadWngXxt6218zfj8I0T4Vc6KkT522NAfw8g5fOaoF50oCggcjaIcTUii6dwB4VHaZaOyPiLgmL5JkLpqzsIsmktd7LHIAO27BQkLyZvQICJf4ub7T8FdoXgpAc12djpoN7u4OMv9bHmCsAKOnEi0o-3Dwg_rCI3uxRaY14PiRXyq3BVd8ABrTIHn3bVLszW972L2Ek2VpV-x4PD5r00nEbiOFLXJ-vHNuzC9_-ezvXQAXRsLJ_da0Lm9iZAKTLv0crcsoSfJj33j9s_eqAbqUNXrhI4Qb92Us96thTJrORbW-X "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---

---

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff8ffcc51e574046b1f57fb5e664c995&_e=ntlE-ziRMv1z70SdgVWmaUp7mkQOU3DYwpD6i8yVt9NtBhOcB9YV6ADZRW398uGWmijZR1NFiEVdXocghxOPDpRkGJV0nZAYraAMPBQd56-YHRoIKKa9wLOHxDaZtWF_fiJcMv6dS9GDLee2FvTuUBOVlcSds8W7VBetnd4XQNF9QChJ4_4eu5IGhaRGTXyqyOIhNz1ThTmLB5xcC134ZcFSRzNbtMEtziL996m8IrwcFrcOl2jyLrErwDPdPGulIdTUoNmstqFhrFcnVztE-fmNcttcpFzY3Hg5re05NQ2Vb_FITtndLXacwmjqeyhRmRFirLDCmQTxnqANSGZRU-7LI-K-nm9q9S6tgHCKAkW1Buq5wEGxBmogELomjjBFq24FWERXEknv3uZ_YDyRBktVZNf3A7-ddejfNC6n4_4%3D "Johnson1")**_

Ron

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Thinking about heaven
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsGNouahNH

Have you ever caught yourself wondering what heaven will be like?
Of course you have.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osGNouahNH

Hello
Friend,
Have you
ever caught yourself wondering what heaven will be like? Of
course you have.
As
Christians, we know someday we will leave this world and be
united with God in heaven, yet many of us know very little about
this place.
The
overwhelming responsibilities of this world - and there are many
- often eclipse our thoughts about the next one. Heaven seems
remote and irrelevant to our existence.
Yet we
all yearn for a better world, especially when we experience
disappointments: a bad report from the doctor, the betrayal of a
friend, the breakup of an intimate relationship, financial
hardship, or the death of a loved one. At those times we want to
believe - we have to believe - that there is a better place.
Over and
over in the Bible, God promises you that there is a better place
... that His people will live with Him forever in a place where
perfect righteousness dwells. Heaven is a real place.
Today, I
want to help elevate your thinking from earthbound concerns to
the hope of heaven and give you a tool to help the grieving,
discouraged, and hurting loved ones in your life.

It is my
joy to offer you my brand-new book, Encouragement from a Place
Called Heaven: Words of Hope About Your Eternal Home, as a
thank-you for your support of Pathway to Victory.

It's a
tremendous resource to help you, or a loved one, find joy and
hope in the promise of heaven.
Along
with the book, I will also send you "What 7 World Religions Teach
About Heaven." It's a comparison resource showing what Christians
believe about heaven compared to the beliefs of other major
religions: Judaism, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Mormonism, and
Jehovah's Witness.
Your gift
to the ministry of Pathway to Victory can be made here:
https://ptv.org/donate/encouragement-from-a-place-called-heaven-generous-gift/
The more
we understand and set our minds on heaven, the more our
perspective of earth will change, impacting our lives and the
lives of those around us.
I pray
these two resources will bless you.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
