name: Ron Johnson
subject: I will humbly ask for your endorsement, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---
| | | [ENDORSE RON JOHNSON](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61393055:JAVNuPVzN:m:1:3331421248:5A1B089CA2193D3770010836272BD6C9:r "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON")
---
Thank you,
Ron Johnson

When I went to Washington after the financial crisis, I learned two important lessons. The first lesson was that you don’t get what you don’t fight for. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau didn’t happen because it was a really good idea. It happened because we fought for it — because we came together as a grassroots movement and demanded it. I also learned that during a crisis, the door to change opens just a crack. What had been impossible becomes hard-but-maybe-possible. That’s the moment to fight with everything you’ve got. Of course, the headwinds will always be fierce. Yeah, change and progress will always be hard. But a crisis — like the Great Recession, like the pandemic, like the fight to save our democracy — shakes up the status quo. People are forced to stop saying “this is how it’s always been” and consider a new thought: “this is how it should be.” We’ve had some good movement on key things like canceling student debt and making sure corporations start paying their fair share. And our ability to continue making progress — on child care, on taxes, on voting rights, on abortion access, and more — will be determined by whether or not we can hold onto our Democratic majorities in the midterms. Now is the time to raise our voices. Now is the time to fight. Side by side, let’s keep working to elect more progressive leaders across the country who will fight to level the playing field for working people. The election of 2020 was another one of those moments when the door to change opened. And what made change possible? An enormous, vital, incredibly powerful force: voters.
Turnout for the election was huge. Two-thirds of America’s eligible population voted in 2020, the highest percentage in more than a century. An estimated twenty million new voters turned out. Millions of young people voted. Millions of people of color voted.
It was a massive outpouring of faith in the idea that voters — not a group of rich, distant power brokers or corrupt politicians — controlled this country.
And that puts us at this pivotal moment in history. The four corrupt and shocking years of Donald Trump’s presidency were topped off by a pandemic, an economic collapse, a national demand for racial justice, and a violent insurrection.
Republicans are doing everything they can to try to reclaim their power and take us back. Right now, we have a critical chance to reject their anti-democratic ways — to shake off who we were and decide who we want to become.
This remarkable moment is an opportunity for change, but not a guarantee that it will happen. Because you don’t get what you don’t fight for.
We can’t let this moment go by without taking bold steps forward for working people across the country. We can reimagine our tax code, with billionaires and giant corporations paying a fair share. We can pass Universal Child Care. We can end the filibuster. We can expand the Court. But first, we must fight.

clean_body: What had been impossible becomes hard-but-maybe-possible. | | | When I went to Washington after the financial crisis, I learned two important lessons. The first lesson was that you don’t get what you don’t fight for. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau didn’t happen because it was a really good idea. It happened because we fought for it — because we came together as a grassroots movement and demanded it. I also learned that during a crisis, the door to change opens just a crack. What had been impossible becomes hard-but-maybe-possible. That’s the moment to fight with everything you’ve got. Of course, the headwinds will always be fierce. Yeah, change and progress will always be hard. But a crisis — like the Great Recession, like the pandemic, like the fight to save our democracy — shakes up the status quo. People are forced to stop saying “this is how it’s always been” and consider a new thought: “this is how it should be.” We’ve had some good movement on key things like canceling student debt and making sure corporations start paying their fair share. And our ability to continue making progress — on child care, on taxes, on voting rights, on abortion access, and more — will be determined by whether or not we can hold onto our Democratic majorities in the midterms. Now is the time to raise our voices. Now is the time to fight. Side by side, let’s keep working to elect more progressive leaders across the country who will fight to level the playing field for working people. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = The election of 2020 was another one of those moments when the door to change opened. And what made change possible? An enormous, vital, incredibly powerful force: voters. Turnout for the election was huge. Two-thirds of America’s eligible population voted in 2020, the highest percentage in more than a century. An estimated twenty million new voters turned out. Millions of young people voted. Millions of people of color voted. It was a massive outpouring of faith in the idea that voters — not a group of rich, distant power brokers or corrupt politicians — controlled this country. And that puts us at this pivotal moment in history. The four corrupt and shocking years of Donald Trump’s presidency were topped off by a pandemic, an economic collapse, a national demand for racial justice, and a violent insurrection. Republicans are doing everything they can to try to reclaim their power and take us back. Right now, we have a critical chance to reject their anti-democratic ways — to shake off who we were and decide who we want to become. This remarkable moment is an opportunity for change, but not a guarantee that it will happen. Because you don’t get what you don’t fight for. We can’t let this moment go by without taking bold steps forward for working people across the country. We can reimagine our tax code, with billionaires and giant corporations paying a fair share. We can pass Universal Child Care. We can end the filibuster. We can expand the Court. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift. In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the "British Bulldog" captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many "academics" and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill's accomplishments more important than ever. For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set: As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you'll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift--before they're gone. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of " Winston Churchill and Statesmanship" on DVD: You'll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill's words and deeds. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College | Sent to Freedom Nation Today subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=746cea35a35745c49523180f62531edb&_e=hxg2JP-LvTNv_itJxh1RsziO5_xBux4jVUb_AgxUVEpeTmYSQrU18MBig3REG2rgSZZZ87hIPrICSM4XiJZddSRq7WLa53-DmFneww7fga6lyjrqXeGblxCZnE1CzXiBpRDwJ1CXyPVkJ_5kFJA_fhHkMRGDH-l6v7r_RUNjC543-vujT4nOkeT78EyZQ1g7TAEeW4MpMJNxGSbPzvyleM03FpR9E0XWAgZdbIFPAqLnq9kIWbhX7cpA32nyGr1EkyfPIGNHc85LyuCTrxKnII1IqnQiNg7PXsGQuDQTyTe_lFmEmwqDyS9f6BK4Nb8PWQBmFo_5MxTdV8itcUBwWJVEgt0jgeDnHHVwrf6Qe3tBZ9eRL0MZbPFxiymQiJPa6NrPap88sb1UpXDIAzZxAq6q6hEXKzxVQ38WycBAVy4%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=746cea35a35745c49523180f62531edb&_e=hxg2JP-LvTNv_itJxh1RsziO5_xBux4jVUb_AgxUVEpeTmYSQrU18MBig3REG2rgSZZZ87hIPrICSM4XiJZddSRq7WLa53-DmFneww7fga6lyjrqXeGblxCZnE1CzXiBpRDwJ1CXyPVkJ_5kFJA_fhHkMRGDH-l6v7r_RUNjC543-vujT4nOkeT78EyZQ1g7TAEeW4MpMJNxGSbPzvyleM03FpR9E0XWAgZdbIFPAqLnq9kIWbhX7cpA32nyGr1EMHA8aXFbV0ClHrDAhwyWl2jpGRgm9NyskyttKUxQk2lbv1yJXS2pki7z1DSFW_ic0SHeB5iBPFibagkysIQg0gFXSWThCmbaZFe5P-xuEPNvST3zjeoEWaPmpfMPKsJW8s29ovi7L6tBlo2dwTsrIA3Y6bHBqZS-aOrzE8CBy0A%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I’m a humble person and hate asking for favors. But I’m nothing without you - I can’t do this on my own.

|
---
| | | Friend, it’s Tim Scott. I only have a minute so I’m going to get straight to the point.

I grew up in a single-parent household and almost failed out of high school. If it weren’t for my supportive mother and mentors, who knows where I would be today.

The American Dream - the possibility of going from cotton to Congress - was never guaranteed to me. Now, I’m committed to making sure that every child has the same opportunities regardless of which side of the tracks they grew up on.

But listen, Friend, winning this fight is impossible without your support.

Friend, it would be an honor if you continued to support me - can you spare $10 to help me continue my fight in the Senate?

Thank you,

Tim Scott

body:
Don Bolduc is a danger to our democracy – plain and simple
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51310869/368977855/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1698-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjU5ZTZhYS1mNzNjLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fUdKPbp01zK_fG2-C6eNIyjRib2H33hQ3vE5KWNxLrE=)
---
In these emails, I often ask you to chip in $3 or $10 to keep “our Senate blue.” And I really do mean **our** Senate because I believe the institutions of our government should belong to, and serve, all Americans.
Unfortunately, it doesn’t seem like my opponent, Don Bolduc, feels the same way.

He has undermined the electoral process – the very _foundation_ of our democracy – by spreading baseless lies about the 2020 election.

He has made it clear that he is (at best) indifferent to the will of the voters, saying he would overturn the results of the 2024 election if he disagreed with them.
And Don Bolduc has even called for **repealing the 17th Amendment,** which would take **away people’s right to elect their own Senators**. That’s right, he doesn’t think that the voters – his would-be constituents – should be able to hold him accountable.
Don Bolduc is a danger to our democracy – plain and simple. And we need to defeat him in November.
**[That starts with people like you stepping up and giving what you can to keep us in this fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51310871/368977857/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1698-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjU5ZTZhYS1mNzNjLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fUdKPbp01zK_fG2-C6eNIyjRib2H33hQ3vE5KWNxLrE=)**
Our Senate belongs to us, the people, and I believe that electing Democrats is how our Senate can best serve all Americans.

And that starts with defending this seat.

With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

Before I even became your nominee, the National Republicans were attacking me.
#

Before I even became your nominee, the National Republicans were attacking me. I was the first challenger in the country the NRSC ran ads against, and my opponent’s super PAC allies are pumping nearly $50 million into this race.
It’s ridiculous. Not just the attacks, but the fact that billionaires and corporate special interests are legally allowed to spend limitless sums to try to buy an election like this.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state and where marriage equality is overturned.
If you believe that we deserve a senator who puts people first, then I need you with me in this fight.

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, there are a total of eight (8) people running to replace Senator Todd Young in Indiana's U.S. Senate race! Over half of the verified candidates have been shut out by journalists who refuse to list all the names of the candidates, shut out by a debate commission that refuses to host all candidates, completely removed from polls, and not mentioned on radio/TV or by political analysts.

**What exactly are they trying to hide? **

Folks, what you are witnessing may very well be the beginning of the end of democracy in this country! I'm reminding you that you have a right to be a fully informed voter. And while the media may try to steer you one way or the other, I'm counting on each of you to fight for your right to information and to know exactly who you have to choose from in this election!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=898e425a7f&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.

Sincerely,

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Please, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61393333:6ZUoGPVNV:m:1:3331421248:BCBC0A7E9B4ADAF2863DA3A93F88647F:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61393334:6ZUoGPVNV:m:1:3331421248:BCBC0A7E9B4ADAF2863DA3A93F88647F:r "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?")**_**************************

During President Trump’s time in the White House, the Republican-controlled Senate was able to approve **not one, not two, but three conservative Supreme Court Justices.** Because of those confirmations, the conservative movement has won significant victories in the Judiciary, including new protections for unborn babies, and protecting our GUNS.

Now, with Joe Biden in office and radical Democrats controlling the Senate, we’re living in a different time.

subject: "Be kind and have good manners."
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
| | |

Peter,

"Be kind and have good manners."
I can't count the times I repeated this mantra to my children – before family gatherings, on the first day of school, at the dinner table. **Above everything else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and respect for others.**
**But frankly, it seems like far too many of the folks running things in Washington lack both.** People are pushing their far-right, out-of-touch ideologies instead of actually helping families. They're picking partisan fights instead of putting their heads down and doing the work. And if my opponent, Eric Schmitt, gets to Washington, he'll be just another extremist with no manners and no kindness.
I promise you, Peter, that I will be different. If there is one thing that sets our campaign apart from others, it's our commitment to hope, kindness, and integrity. And I am proud that every member of my team exemplifies these values each day.
Even on long days on RV trips all over Missouri, we make sure to listen to every voter with the same sincerity and focus; we make time to hear their stories; we ask them to share their concerns; and we invite them to be a part of the solutions. Whether you've cast your ballot for red or blue in the past, you have a place in our state and in our movement.
**As senator, I will treat everyone – my colleagues, my constituents, and every person who comes through my office doors – with the manners and compassion that my parents taught me, and which I passed on to my own kids.** I will always lead with kindness, respect, and a listening ear.
**But in order to get there and bring this commitment to Washington, I need your help.[Please, can I count on you to make a donation to help me flip this seat blue and bring kindness and respect to Washington? body:
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/OmA59V8DvrZnKhjWm8TBSygQrFA87IFBoq58lAbx9ts=/1-ZmWM6vn31LJK3kGOPCJNSmFqYGC11Nkcl7ZnHSnoI=)
---
If I spoke up every time Republicans spread misinformation about abortions, I would have _no time_ left for myself. But, following Stacey Abram's lead from last week, I want to clarify some *especially* relevant issues.
Lindsey Graham introduced a nationwide 15-week abortion ban. **But that 's weeks before a common health screening that would pick up on abnormalities or health conditions -- AND long before the fetus is actually viable.**
Other states have passed 6-week abortion bans, claiming that's when you can hear a "heartbeat." **But six-week fetuses aren 't even _close_ to having a developed heart.**

name: Mark Kelly
subject: A near-total ban on abortion in Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Today, my granddaughter has fewer rights than my mother did.
#

I wish I had better news, friends.
A judge in Arizona just reinstated a law passed over 150 years ago, before Arizona was even a state. The law bans abortions in nearly all cases, including rape and incest. Under this law, providers would be jailed for performing abortions.
Arizona is my home. It is my daughters' home, my granddaughter's home.
And today, they have fewer rights than my mother did.
I know times like these are scary, and I know you've dealt with more than your fair share over the past few years. But we are not powerless. And we cannot give up.
Not today. Not when we're just weeks from an election that will determine control of the U.S. Senate. Not while extremist candidates across the country — including my opponent — are publicly, shamelessly calling for national abortion bans and jailing doctors.
[**It's up to us to stop them. Donate $3 and help me defend this seat.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept22.nZ-xom&refcode=em220925-1-7&t=1&akid=3983%2E6688874%2EHLjeuG)
You have my word: I'll keep up the fight to restore abortion rights in the Senate. But please, take care of yourselves. I need you with me to get this done.
All my best,

Gabe needs your help today to ensure we reach our end-of-quarter goal by Friday at midnight. Can you rush $10 or more to fuel our campaign in these final weeks? name: Team Jayapal
subject: We have to maintain a Democratic majority
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
In Washington State, we’re holding the line against GOP extremists.
#
Peter,
The upcoming midterm elections couldn't be more important, and we need all hands on deck.
It’s critical that we hold our Democratic majority in the House and at least break even in the Senate. But that’s not going to come easy, which is why Pramila has said over and over again, **that we MUST re-elect Democrats and expand our ranks in Congress.**
Right here in Washington, several Democrats are facing tough campaigns against extreme Republicans. Our power is in our numbers. **That’s why Pramila is supporting Senator Patty Murray, Representative Kim Schrier, and Democratic Nominee Marie Gluesenkamp Perez.**
[**These Democratic women leaders will fight alongside Pramila in Congress to safeguard our rights from the extreme Republicans threatening our communities. So will you join us and support them with a split donation between our campaigns?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17740?refcode=em20220925-1654&t=1&akid=1654%2E420207%2ExltXtN)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17740?refcode=em20220925-1654&t=2&akid=1654%2E420207%2ExltXtN)**
Senator Patty Murray is being challenged by a MAGA candidate who celebrated the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ and approves of extreme abortion bans in states like Texas. Now people are saying it’s a “surprisingly close race” after new polls show the Republican challenger within striking distance of Senator Murray.
**We can’t afford to lose a single Senate seat.**
Representative Kim Schrier is a former pediatrician facing an extreme Republican candidate. In stark contrast to her strong pro-choice record, this Republican wants abortion bans with NO exceptions for rape or incest, and also refuses to admit President Biden won the 2020 Presidential election.
**We need to re-elect every pro-choice representative in Congress.**
Marie Gluesenkamp Perez is a pro-choice mother and small business owner who will fight for working families if she’s elected to represent Washington’s 3rd district. She’s up against an extreme rightwing candidate who is endorsed by Trump, believes all abortion should be illegal, and has declared the 2020 election “stolen.”
**We must support Democrats in Washington State and stand up against GOP election deniers.**
[**Will you split a donation today between Pramila, Patty, Kim, and Marie to support critical Democrats and help us all hold the line against Republican extremists in our state?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17740?refcode=em20220925-1654&t=3&akid=1654%2E420207%2ExltXtN)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

subject: Karamo’s anti-choice beliefs (extreme)
disclaimer_text:

Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend,

We know that Trump-endorsed Kristina Karamo represents a clear threat to democracy. But her extremist opposition to reproductive rights makes her dangerous to the liberties of Michiganders.

Not only does Karamo believe in an outright abortion ban, including cases of rape and incest, she has called the medical procedure “satanic” and equivalent to “child sacrifice.” And at her nominating convention, she said fighting against abortion rights was the reason why she got into politics in the first place.

Clearly she’s missing the fact that the office of secretary of state does not have the power to decide abortion policy. But imagine an official with such pathological and extremist anti-choice opinions serving statewide in Michigan? If taking away a woman’s right to choose was the sole reason Karamo ran for secretary of state, you can guarantee this focus would distract her from performing the essential duties of the office.
At best, this could mean the failure to process drivers licenses in a timely manner or the return of chaotic wait times at offices.
At worst, she could use her statewide position of power to push her extremist positions on the state and interfere with the counting of votes to advance extreme ideological beliefs.

If her anti-democratic rhetoric is any indication, Karamo would attempt to bend the powers of the office to advocate against abortion rights in Michigan.
This November, Michiganders will have a choice. They can support Jocelyn Benson, a proven leader who is focused on the right things, like slashing wait times to 20 minutes or less and who believes in free and fair elections for all, OR they can support an election denier who is obsessed with eliminating a woman’s right to choose forever.

We’ve had a lot on our plate these past months. But supporters like you have demonstrated the strength our community has, even in times of adversity.

There is so much to be thankful for — the resilience of our community, the generosity of our neighbors, and the promise of a better future.

I wish you and your family a happy, healthy, and sweet New Year.

Shana Tova!

Josh

Team,
Elissa’s first debate just aired! There was one moment that you may see trending on Twitter -- check out the viral clip where Eli ssa's opponent makes it clear he opposes any exceptions for abortion [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925]
Unfortunately, there was an issue with the livestream, so if you weren’t able to catch it live you can watch the full debate here on the WDIV Youtube channel: CLICK HERE [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bdLQ1WJlJYM] . [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bdLQ1WJlJYM]
Here were the key takeaways:
Elissa’s opponent confirmed that he does not support any exceptions for abortion. The moderator asked him point-blank whether he supported exceptions for rape and incest—not once, not twice, but four times. And every time, his robotic response was the same: “I’m pro-life.”
Elissa is Team USA when it comes to jobs, but her opponent doesn’t want to pick a side. We don’t need to remind you that Elissa’s opponent voted *5 times* against the bipartisan GM deal that brought 5,000 jobs to his backyard. In the debate, he presented no plan to keep jobs and investment in the United States. Elissa made her stance on this issue perfectly clear:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925]
Elissa is the only candidate even trying to bring prices down for Michigan families. Elissa is directly attacking the costs that families face every day. She wrote legislation to suspend the federal gas tax, pushed the Biden administration to use our Strategic National Reserves and get tough on oil-producing partners, and voted to lower the price of prescription drugs. Her opponent couldn’t offer a single concrete proposal of how he’d tackle rising prices outside of blaming the administration.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925]
Bottom line, the theme of this first debate was: are you someone who only repeats political talking points fed by consultants, or are you going to knuckle down and get to work? Elissa made her priority perfectly clear.
If you enjoyed the debate, consider chipping in here as Elissa runs in one of the most competitive (and the MOST expensive) House races in the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email220925]
And make sure you check out Elissa’s second debate, which will air live on WLNS, Channel 6 in Lansing (we’ll make sure to follow up with a link if you want to follow online) on October 6th at 7:00 PM.

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: I am writing to ask you to contribute $3 directly to Katie Hobbs campaign for Governor. If you haven’t heard the news from Arizona, please let me explain...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
On Friday night, Arizona enacted an abortion ban from 1901 with no exceptions for rape and incest.

Friends -
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a donation directly to Katie Hobbs’ campaign for Governor of Arizona. Please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially this weekend — is so important.
If you’ve already heard the news and are ready to give, please use this link to donate directly to her campaign:
[**https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/Hobbs**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-hobbs?refcode=em-220925-1-subs-a&refcode2=959_4767699_70wyCW&akid=959%2E4767699%2E70wyCW)
Otherwise, here’s the truth:
On Friday night, Arizona enacted an abortion ban from 1901 with no exceptions for rape and incest.
It’s a near total ban that puts women at risk, and more than ever Arizona needs a governor who will protect a woman’s right to choose.
But that is not all.
Katie Hobbs is running against an extreme Republican, Kari Lake, whose central thesis of the primary was that the 2020 election was stolen in Arizona and said it was “disqualifying” that her opponent would not agree.
But let me be as blunt as I can be here:
The Governor of Arizona certifies presidential election results. And if you think — for a single second — Kari Lake would sign-off on ANY Democrat winning Arizona in 2024, then you are mistaken.
Katie Hobbs, the Democrat, is the current Secretary of State. She stood up to the Big Lie in a crucial state and took a lot of far-right hate for it.
We need her as Governor of Arizona. So here’s the part where I ask:
[**Can you PLEASE rush a $3 contribution to Katie Hobbs’ campaign for Governor today? Early voting starts soon, and we can help her fill some budget gaps to reach more voters before they cast their ballots.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-hobbs?refcode=em-220925-1-subs-a&refcode2=959_4767699_70wyCW&akid=959%2E4767699%2E70wyCW)
[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-hobbs?refcode=em-220925-1-subs-a&refcode2=959_4767699_70wyCW&akid=959%2E4767699%2E70wyCW)
What we do for Katie Hobbs today could make a huge difference in the outcome of this race.
Thank you,
Gavin

Pundits told us from the beginning that this seat would be a toss-up, and the GOP was listening. These past few months, our team has been in the battle of our lives against GOP bigwigs and their dark money. It’s why we’ve always said that as we’d get closer to the election, Republican spending in this race is going to skyrocket.
Well, here we are now and **they’re not done funneling money into this district just yet.**
The Republican Party has their ideal candidate in my opponent, April Becker. She’s the most far-right candidate to have ever run in this district, is a full-blown election denier, and is running her campaign based on Donald Trump’s playbook.
I’m being serious when I say that April is in this race for her own gain, too. **When she lost her previous State Senate race, she filed two lawsuits to overturn the results.**

Jenna's Promise: When: Tuesday, September 27, 5:30-7pm Where: Jenna's Promise, 117 St. Johns St, Burlington Join Jenna's Promise in having a community conversation with Brenda! Brenda has been a long time advocate on healing the overdose crisis, and deeply values the work that Jenna's Promise does for the community and state. Brenda has the personal experience of having lost two family members to overdose, and knows that Vermonters in every corner of the state are being impacted by this crisis. Brenda has successfully worked on drug policy across the state and country, and is deeply committed to ending the overdose crisis, making it a priority of her administration. All are welcome. We want you all to be there! | Jenna's Promise: When: Tuesday, September 27, 5:30-7pm Where: Jenna's Promise, 117 St. Johns St, Burlington Join Jenna's Promise in having a community conversation with Brenda! Brenda has been a long time advocate on healing the overdose crisis, and deeply values the work that Jenna's Promise does for the community and state. Brenda has the personal experience of having lost two family members to overdose, and knows that Vermonters in every corner of the state are being impacted by this crisis. Brenda has successfully worked on drug policy across the state and country, and is deeply committed to ending the overdose crisis, making it a priority of her administration. All are welcome. Doors open at 5:30pm. | Debate Watch Party: When: Wednesday, September 28, 6-10pm Where: Church St. Tavern, 103 Church St, Burlington Debate starts at 6:00pm sharp Come cheer on Brenda with us while she debates our Republican Governor, joined by Brenda in the last hour! There will be a cash bar, food, and lots of good times. Masks are encouraged, as this is an indoor event. All are welcome. | House Party: When: Sunday, October 2, 6-8pm Where: Arshad Hasan's home; 120 South Champlain St, Burlington Join us to celebrate the incredible work Brenda's done, already winning across the state! We are ready for housing for all, heal the overdose crisis, end climate change, and support reproductive rights for all. We know that when we all rise together, we can make change. We are coming together to celebrate all the success thus far of this campaign, and to continue pushing our momentum forward into the general election! All are welcome. We hope to see you attend at least one of these exciting events! Come to hear what Brenda will do to create a Vermont that works for all of us. All are welcome! Derek,
The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic attacks on the right to vote, on a woman's right to choose, and on our children's right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.
Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.
Despite all of that — or maybe because of all of that — Texans are standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It's inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have taken this campaign to literally every part of the state — showing up for everyone and writing no one off.
But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever entered the race. He'll use that to lie to voters about my record and try to keep them from turning out. And there's a chance he'll succeed if we don't have the resources to fight back.

### **New Ad Alert!**
As an independent governor, Betsy is the only candidate who can fix our state – she’ll lead with the best ideas from both parties and that’s exactly what we need to move Oregon forward.
Check out Betsy’s latest ad, “Only,” and share it with your family and friends across Oregon!
[](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/ad_only?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news_5&n=4)
* * *
### **Bend Debate Watch Party**
The next gubernatorial debate will take place Tuesday, Sept. 27 from 6:00-7:30pm at the OSU-Cascades campus in Bend. The debate will be aired on NewsChannel 21-KTVZ in Bend, and via livestream on ktvz.com and on the NewsChannel 21 app.
If you’re in the Bend area and want to join fellow supporters to cheer on Betsy, there will be a debate watch party at River Pig Saloon in Bend (555 NW Arizona Ave #40, Bend, OR 97703). Everyone is welcome!
* * *

Fellow Conservative,

**If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race.**

It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase **I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path.**

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

Cheri Beasley’s campaign in North Carolina is one of our best chances to flip a seat.

After the Supreme Court completely overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , a flurry of state legislatures imposed complete or near complete bans on abortion.

In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country? Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.But I think there is much, much more to this power grab. Ask yourself this: Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families? Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country. Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money. But to me, it’s just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It’s about more freedom vs. more government control. It’s about whether we serve the government ... or whether the government serves us. I need to hear from you today: do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people? Peter,
Wade is continuing his promise to be present all over the First District – with campaign stops all over GA-01!
Last Saturday, Wade spent the day with local elected officials – first at breakfast with the Liberty County Democratic Committee and then in Savannah at Reclaim the Soul of Voting at Forsyth Park, hosted by the Deltas. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-09-19-143856_009_edit.gif]
Then we headed to the Glynn County Democratic Committee picnic where Wade spoke to the crowd about the importance of this year’s election. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-09-19-143908_002_edit.jpg]
Yesterday, Wade spoke at a press conference hosted by the Democratic Party of Georgia along with Mayor Van Johnson and Georgia State Rep. Mary Robichaux to reinforce how extreme Republicans like Buddy Carter are planning to go on restricting abortion. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-09-24-130328_edit.jpg]
We wrapped up the day at Waffle House where Wade got a chance to step behind the grill and serve up some hashbrowns the only way he knows how: Scattered, smothered, & covered! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/signal-2022-09-25-160540_004_edit.jpg]
Today after church, Wade went to Day of Peace at Daffin Park in Savannah – a gathering to bring people and organizations together to promote peace and anti-violence initiatives. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/_B6B8143_edit.jpg]
Peter, we are close to 6 weeks away from November 8th, early voting starts in a few weeks, and our last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is coming up this Friday, September 30th.
We’re thankful to have your support as the campaign speeds up!
Onwards,
The Wade Brigade

### Adnan Syed's saga in Baltimore proved how deeply fascism has grown entrenched in America, as San Francisco turned back the clock on civil liberties and civil rights
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4813f60c-dc6f-4083-ba82-11d4767a0f17?r=1hvr60)| [Shahid Buttar](https://substack.com/redirect/4813f60c-dc6f-4083-ba82-11d4767a0f17?r=1hvr60)| | Sep 25

Last week, a pair of events on opposite sides of the country offered revealing lessons about our country's continuing confusion on criminal justice and institutional corruption. They indicate that the movement to challenge police abuses and achieve a modicum of justice may be taking three steps back for every two forward.
Below, I explain recent events in Baltimore and San Francisco before offering my analysis of each the San Francisco Supervisors who voted last week to expand police surveillance. Four, in particular, especially invite accountability.
After decades of imprisonment for a murder he did not commit, Adnan Syed was finally freed from prison in Baltimore last Monday, and may be soon exonerated based on forthcoming results of a DNA test. His release is a triumph for a man and his family, but also a disturbing indication (as an exception proving the broader rule) of our system's arbitrary and pervasive presumptions of guilt.
> Especially as corporate outsourcing has hollowed out America's manufacturing base, mass incarceration has emerged as our nation's industrial labor model. A commitment to mass slavery-for-profit in fact strays far closer to the example of Nazi Germany than any American might care to acknowledge.
The very next day, officials across the country in San Francisco proved that they learned nothing from either Adnan's case or the broader discourse about the abuses pervading the criminal justice system across the U.S. In response to a proposal from our shamelessly pro-police mayor, the Board of Supervisors by a 7-4 vote [adopted a proposal](https://substack.com/redirect/fc00cfdb-8234-4704-acf9-6b46cb407141?r=1hvr60) that expanded the surveillance powers of local police, despite a previous 2019 ordinance--for which [I advocated](https://substack.com/redirect/d0aa0db6-784f-448c-ac17-08ec8290f436?r=1hvr60)--that imposed [first-of-their-kind restrictions](https://substack.com/redirect/11797457-01da-4f30-8b05-688ae7f53175?r=1hvr60) on the secret acquisition of unconstitutional surveillance technology by local law-enforcement authorities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ed101a2-d307-4c8f-9977-63c45993cb90?r=1hvr60)|

[Share](https://open.substack.com/pub/shahidbuttar/p/justice-delayed-and-justice-denied?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6NzQ0NTUwNjcsImlhdCI6MTY2NDEzODY4MywiZXhwIjoxNjY2NzMwNjgzLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMTAxODU5NyIsInN1YiI6InBvc3QtcmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.t0xnaFwk4MmH5qMAFcL8P_aamoamYtUbNZffwZ0LqFQ)
### An exception proves the rule
Adnan Syed was convicted in Baltimore as a teenager of murdering his ex girlfriend in 1999, even though prosecutors knew about legitimate suspects who they chose not to pursue, and suppressed evidence at trial indicating his innocence that they were constitutionally obligated to disclose. It took 23 years for a judge to demand that prosecutors finally prove their case.
Many observers focused on how Adnan's case was extraordinary. He was the subject of a documentary podcast, sustained international media attention, the activism of a wide community of people spanning decades, and may become the beneficiary of forensic DNA evidence unavailable to most prisoners jailed for crimes they did not commit.
While these exceptions are rare, however, the problems indicated by his false imprisonment are from it. As [NPR put](https://substack.com/redirect/d3761248-822f-41a1-8900-7cf84bba9d1f?r=1hvr60) it, "Adnan Syed's case is unique. Withholding of potentially exculpatory evidence is not."
Adnan's long overdue release indicates more, however, then merely the arbitrary nature of what we in the United States idiotically describe as so-called "justice." Beyond the disturbing specter of arbitrary punishment impacting innocent people is _an industrial paradigm_ supported by mass incarceration.
Not only is Adnan's exoneration an exception that proves a disturbing rule, but the corruption incentivizing that rule is even worse than the tragic harms--lost careers, years, homes, relationships, and even lives--endured by millions of people and their even wider ranging families.
For instance, Adnan's case demonstrates the particular incentive for district attorneys to seek convictions. That narrow target unfortunately forces sharp departures from justice when, for instance, families are broken to impose jail or prison sentences on breadwinners who could be rehabilitated rather than simply incapacitated. To a public committed to carceral punishment, district attorneys are elected based on a transactional expectation of involuntarily detaining people en masse.
That is a fundamentally authoritarian--and ultimately fascist--presumption, deeply embedded in the American psyche and public consciousness. It is one that even most self-described liberals have failed to interrogate at all, and we have developed effectively no institutional response to contain.
Elections, like the one this summer that recalled the democratically elected district attorney of San Francisco, Chesa Boudin, have been effectively reduced to knee-jerk contests among jailers to see who can brag about incarcerating more of their neighbors.
Chesa's recall, mind you, happened in a particular city that has long claimed to unite behind supposedly "progressive" values. Led by the San Francisco Chronicle (against which [I am currently waging a lawsuit in federal court](https://substack.com/redirect/fefb8100-c4e6-4ef6-a12b-26d5140786ad?r=1hvr60) to challenge the reckless and malicious publication of racist election disinformation), publications across the city have fanned the flames of liberal mania, brainwashing San Franciscans into imagining that they live in Batman's Gotham City or Daredevil's Hell's Kitchen.
Having lived on the South Side of Chicago, and NorthEast DC, the pattern reeks of ignorance and entitlement. Comfortable capitalists--people with investments--routinely blame property crimes on those ultimately trying to survive. When reform-minded change agents do challenge the system, as Boudin did in his capacity (and I did in mine), they become demonized by weaponized journalism, reduced to charicatures on which any number of negative projections can be cast.
While the press whips the public into a carceral frenzy facilitated by the courts, lost in the absent public conversation is any discussion of the legitimate public safety concerns hijacked by authoritarians across the political spectrum. From San Francisco's rare Republicans, to the proudly ignorant self-described "liberal"-yet-ultimately-both-racist-and-authoritarian "[white moderate](https://substack.com/redirect/e7054afa-06c5-446d-ab36-9963fe050d5a?r=1hvr60)" majority that dominates the Democratic Party, a disturbing tendency towards authoritarianism has taken root.
Beyond retribution (punishment), more worthy goals of criminal justice might include rehabilitation (preventing the recurrence of crime and returning perpetrators to society) or deterrence (discouraging future crime). Yet mass incarceration and presumptive guilt (both of which are strictly retrospective) actually support neither of those goals.
Some look at the tragedy of false imprisonment and mass incarceration through the lens of the individuals whose lives they destroy and their families. From their perspectives, it is certainly a horrific dynamic involving the deprivation of basic rights and outright human rights abuses.
But mass incarceration is even worse than the harms endured by its victims. Private companies profit from detaining people. Worse yet, they work alongside allies including police unions to contrive public policies that expand authoritarian policies and enable social control. The institutional corruption underlying the paradigm of mass industrial slavery is a horror that reveals what this country--despite its self-serving rhetoric--is ultimately about.
## A "progressive" city turns its back on itself
From government contracts for private prisons to public policies that allow police & prosecutors the arbitrary power to railroad people into false convictions, a litany of factors combine to contrive mass slavery. They range from legislative policies--like [the ones I ran for Congress to try to change](https://substack.com/redirect/4fb793b7-3dd7-486d-b92f-bf72828e6699?r=1hvr60) at the federal level--to the practices of local executive officials.
Last Tuesday, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors voted 7-4 to accept a proposal from Mayor London Breed to expand the surveillance powers of local police, despite a 2019 ordinance passed by the Board that (at the time) represented the high water mark of the national movement to protect civil rights and civil liberties at the local level.
The ordinance we won in 2019 required police to seek civilian permission before accessing surveillance technology, and prohibited them from using biased facial recognition software at all. The prohibition on municipal facial recognition was the first of its kind in the country.
Mayor Breed, a staunch ally of the San Francisco Police Department, previously proposed a ballot measure to overturn our 2019 ordinance entirely, before then [withdrawing it](https://substack.com/redirect/138e4b79-81c4-41d4-af91-9738bbb6b3c2?r=1hvr60) and then proposing a new compromise that merely waters down the Board of Supervisors' historic previous decision. In particular, the new policy passed by the Board of Supervisors gives police real-time access to surveillance footage owned by private individuals and businesses, subject to their consent and certain (relatively meager) limits.
While the compromise is less damaging than the ballot measure would have been, it continues to undermine civilian oversight of police activities. This support for surveillance without civilian oversight--even at the local level in a supposedly "progressive" enclave despite recent political resistance--reinforces the corruption of a security industrial complex, and reveals the strength of its political tentacles.
Beyond the Mayor's recent proposal adopted by the Board of Supervisors are other decisions by local executive officials--particular the District Attorney--that pose grave threats to justice. For instance, plea bargaining has encouraged a prosecutorial pattern and practice of overcharging defendants in order to induce them to waive their constitutional rights to trial. Boudin had made a practice of not overcharging, which his successor, Brooke Jenkins, appears poised to reverse.
When a defendant faces an untenably brutal sentence, it's not crazy to accept the opportunity to secure a more lenient one by abandoning the often impossible effort to prove one's innocence in the face of the various biases supporting presumptive guilt. Recall Adnan Syed's case, and how even an obviously innocent person can be imprisoned in the U.S. for decades despite widespread outrage.
## An elephant in every room
But it's worse than simply intimidating individuals into resigning their rights, and forcing families to live without breadwinners. Entire communities suffer, as does the very principle of justice towards which our system was theoretically aimed in the first place.
Repeat that pattern over and over again, millions of times across the country, for generations, and imagine what might happen.
It is, however, worse than even that. The [13th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution](https://substack.com/redirect/e33e06e5-eb2c-45b3-8ac6-7eaf8f71fac4?r=1hvr60) indicates why: it reports to abolish slavery, _but explicitly allows it to continue as a condition of punishment upon conviction_. Every person convicted of a felony, and many misdemeanors--whether through a trial or a plea bargain--stands at risk of being subjected to forced labor.
Especially as corporate outsourcing has hollowed out America's manufacturing base, mass incarceration has emerged as our nation's industrial labor model. A commitment to mass slavery-for-profit in fact strays far closer to the example of Nazi Germany than any American might care to acknowledge.
The accreted accumulated impact of denying Americans their Sixth Amendment rights in the service of building a slave labor force has never been adequately studied. It is certainly not adequately understood, even by advocates for prison abolition.
Casual observers of local broadcast news reinforce the rule that "if it bleeds it leads," which, in turn, brainwash Americans to imagine crime waves based on the combination of occasional horrific incidents, constant TV crime dramas, and Hollywood action blockbusters all reinforcing an impression of insecurity.
The systemic rot runs deeper than most acknowledge.
I celebrate Adnan's exoneration. Beyond his case, however the horror of mass slavery in America--let's not dignify it by reducing it to "incarceration"-- grows worse with every passing day.
Mass slavery is an obvious indication of authoritarianism. I hope more Americans come to recognize it before they find the opportunity to shift directions becomes unfortunately unavailable.
Welcome to America in 2022!

body:
| Hey,

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic attacks on the right to vote, on a woman's right to choose, and on our children's right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.

Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the nation's most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.

Despite all of that -- or maybe because of all of that -- Texans are standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It's inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have taken this campaign to literally every part of the state -- showing up for everyone and writing no one off.

But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever entered the race. He'll use that to lie to voters about my record and try to keep them from turning out. And there's a chance he'll succeed if we don't have the resources to fight back. [So I need your help, to make sure we can hire more organizers, open new field offices, run ads, and ultimately reach all of the voters who will decide this election. subject: Planning our October budget
body:
| Hey team, it’s Patrick Denny — the Moore for Maryland finance director. **Right now, we’re just five days away from our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the general election.** I know you get a lot of emails asking for money, but believe me when I say that contributions to messages like these truly make a difference for our movement. As our next deadline approaches and Election Day is only 44 days away, we’re currently planning our October campaign budget and finalizing how much we can afford to spend on TV ads, signs, mailers, organizers, and more to ensure we get out the vote for Wes. Reaching our fundraising goals directly impacts how much we can allocate in this final leg of the race. **As of right now, we’re not on track to hit our goal by Friday at midnight. Can you help us catch up and raise $50,000 from emails like this one by pitching in $10 or more right now?** **Here’s a personal link to make your donation:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-email-sep2022/personal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51324165/369006833/-2123748265?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220925eoq1_pd_odpf90ds_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTJkNzllMi0xYTNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pfTDHxvyKNRmpfHrU98-aciq1idLfSuI7M9hHHQ6VM8=)** Thanks for all you do to help make Wes the next Governor of Maryland! — Patrick

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek,

It’s me, Stacey Abrams.

I want you to envision this: It’s a sunny day in January. The clouds are
hanging high in the sky and crowds of Georgians are celebrating at the
steps of the State Capitol in Atlanta.

It’s Inauguration Day and we did it. We made history. We won.

Derek. Ousting a
voter-suppressing governor with an extremist agenda is no easy feat. Will
you pitch in $25 — or even $5 — to make this
vision a reality? We’re going to need everyone, and I mean everyone, in
our corner now and every day until Election Day.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220925_B3_FirstYear_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=9455%2E1862389%2EnG6CH8 ]DONATE

to imagine that first day that I take office,
Derek.

I want you to imagine what we can get done in that first year — through

— We can expand Medicaid to ensure access to healthcare and more jobs.

prosecutions.

Georgia’s economy.

to invest in our people without raising taxes.

And we can remove Brian Kemp and his extreme, anti-democratic agenda from
the governor’s mansion.

I want you to imagine what we can get done in that first year — through the power of the governor’s office alone. — We can expand Medicaid to ensure access to healthcare and more jobs. — We can defend reproductive freedom by deprioritizing abortion-related prosecutions. — We can establish a $10 million Small Business Investment Fund to boost Georgia’s economy. — We can put money in Georgians’ pockets by using our $5 billion+ surplus to invest in our people without raising taxes. And we can remove Brian Kemp and his extreme, anti-democratic agenda from the governor’s mansion. [ ]But with only a few days until our next big end-of-month fundraising deadline, we can’t just sit back and dream about the day Kemp is no longer in office. We have to make it happen. So, will you contribute $5 today and give us the momentum to take us past the finish line and right to Inauguration Day? clean_body: I can’t stress how important this last stretch is. | | | Peter, let’s play a game of “would you rather.” Would you rather... ... live in a world where affordable, quality health care is a human right or sell plates of BBQ in order for your sick loved ones to survive? ... see bipartisan gun safety solutions keep our kids and families safe or continue to sacrifice our children’s lives for the gun industry’s profits? ... get reproductive care close to home when you need it because that care is protected as a right in Texas, or travel hundreds or even thousands of miles to get the health care you need? Here’s the thing: This isn’t a game. It’s the reality of what kind of future we can expect for South Texas — and it comes down to whether we are able to beat Monica De La Cruz in November and elect a real champion for the people in TX-15. defeat MAGA candidate Kari Lake and protect women’s reproductive freedom.

I am outraged and devastated by this decision – and we have to fight back.

This cruel law effectively outlaws abortion in Arizona — with no
exceptions for rape or incest — and ends women’s fundamental freedom to
make our own health care decisions. As a social worker, I’ve seen
first-hand how restricting women’s autonomy and creating barriers to
reproductive health care hurts women’s physical and mental wellbeing, and
I’m terrified of the consequences this bill will have on Arizona women and
families.

To make matters worse, this law mandates jail time for abortion providers.
Medical professionals will now be forced to think twice and call their
lawyer before providing patients with oftentimes necessary, lifesaving
care.

Make no mistake: this outcome is the product of a decades-long attack on
reproductive freedom. And Kari Lake’s full-throated support of this
dangerous law shows how far she is willing to go to take away Arizonans’
freedoms and put our health on the line.
